verses.author: model_A
verses.text: A boat leaves the harbor before anyone is awake to see it go.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
wet footprints on the dock,
already fading
before the sun can ask whose

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the coffee still warm
in a cup no one claims —
morning keeps its secrets

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the gulls know something,
circling where the water
still remembers a shape

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a bell rings once
from a buoy no one set —
the harbor answers anyway

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone left the porch light on
though the house has been sold for years —
even absence keeps a schedule

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the new owners haven't come yet
so the garden decides for itself
which flowers are worth keeping

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the fence leans a little more each winter
not falling exactly —
just asking to be noticed

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a crow tests the leaning post,
finds it sturdy enough for now —
some things just need one more spring

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone's boot prints in the mud
already filling with rain—
the garden doesn't ask who's coming, only when

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the old apple tree drops one more
before the frost takes the rest —
even endings want to be generous

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the porch light stays on for no one now
but I turn it off last, always—
someone should be the one who checks

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the kettle knows before I do
that two cups was always one too many—
still, I warm them both

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the mail still comes addressed to both of us—
I let it pile by the door a while
before I learn the new shape of my name

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the closet holds his coat a season longer—
not grief exactly, just
the shape a doorway remembers

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the dog still waits by the gate at five—
I've stopped explaining
that some clocks don't get the news
